# Ship 32 (S32)

[1](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Ship_32_(S32)#articleComments) [Sign In to SaveSave](https://auth.fandom.com/register?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fstarship-spacex.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FShip_32_%28S32%29%3Fcollections%3Dsave&uselang=en&metadata=collections-save-button "Sign In to Save") [Edit](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Ship_32_(S32)?veaction=edit)

**Ship 32** (S32) was a Starship second stage prototype, which was the final Block 1 ship to be stacked. Following stacking, S32 saw no further work and was stored in the [Rocket Garden](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Rocket_Garden "Rocket Garden") for the majority of its existence. It was scrapped just under 15 months after completing stacking, following the decision many months before to go ahead with Block 2 and not fly S32.

## History\[ [Edit section: History](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Ship_32_(S32)?veaction=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")\]

Ship 32 was first spotted around the beginning of 2023 (January or February), and completed stacking in the [High Bay](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/High_Bay "High Bay"). Stacking was finished on the 16th of November 2023, taking 36 days from start to completion. S32 was moved to the [Rocket Garden](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Rocket_Garden "Rocket Garden") just under 2 months after completing stacking. It was then been moved to the [Sanchez Site](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Sanchez_Site "Sanchez Site") on the 25th of September 2024 and finally back to [High Bay](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/High_Bay "High Bay") on February 7, 2025, for scrapping.

## Timeline\[ [Edit section: Timeline](https://starship-spacex.fandom.com/wiki/Ship_32_(S32)?veaction=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Timeline")\]

OpenClick to view the pre-stacking timeline:

- 20 March 2023: S32 aft stiffened barrel scrapped for pucker made on wo 2795094 do not use for flight.
- 27 March 2023: S32 scrapped aft barrel attached to crane.
- 3 June 2023: S32 NC leaves tent 3
- 30 August 2023: S32 payload bay door installed.
- 9 October 2023: S32's NC35 moved into the Ring Yard from Tent 3.

OpenClick to view stacking timeline:

- 11 October 2023: S32's NC35 moved into the High Bay for stacking; S32 PL:5 moved into the High Bay for stacking; S32's NC35 stacked atop PL:5 creating N:5.
- 16 October 2023: S32 FX:3 moved into the High Bay for stacking.
- 18 October 2023: S32 N:5 stacked on FX:3 creating N:8.
- 21 October 2023: S32 CX:4 moved into the High Bay for stacking.
- 24 October 2023: S32 N:8 stacked on CX:4 creating N:12.
- 2 November 2023: S32 ML:4 moved into High Bay for stacking.
- 3 November 2023: S32 N:12 stacked on ML:4 creating N:16.
- 16 November 2023: S32 AX:4 moved into the High Bay; S32 N:16 stacked on AX:4 **completing the stacking for S32 after 36 days from start to completion.**

OpenClick to view post-stacking timeline:

- 11 Jan 2024: S32 moved to Rocket Garden
- 25 Sep 2024: S32 moves from its parking spot in the rocket garden to the spot formerly occupied by the engine installation stand at the Sanchez Site
- 7 Feb 2025: Ship 32 is moved into the Highbay
- 10 Feb 2025: S32 AX:4 cut off of S32 beginning the scrapping of the vehicle
- 15 Mar 2025: RGV flyover reveals all the S32 sections have been scrapped
